title: Taskade Launch Video 01
script: A lot of small businesses use one tool for notes, another for tasks, another for AI, and then still follow up manually. I wanted to see if Taskade could simplify that. I built a basic lead follow-up workflow: a new request comes in, the AI classifies it, creates the next task, drafts a response, and puts it into a pipeline for human review. I would not let AI send important commercial replies by itself, but for organizing repetitive work this is actually useful. I put the full test and the tool link on my page.
